annotation.justification: The clause is clear and unambiguous. It specifies that an endpoint must treat a change to SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE that causes any flow-control window to exceed the maximum size as a connection error of type FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR. There is no ambiguity in the language or in the conditions under which the error must be triggered.
